name: @kennyfrc/pi-system-reminders
description: Transient and durable system reminders for Pi — a durability state machine on the context event. Transient reminders re-derive per evaluation at a clock edge (turn:start | call:every | tool:error) and never persist; durable reminders are persisted once as a session message before the session's first user prompt (same <system_reminder> envelope, user-role wire shape, durable="true" marker) and replay in every subsequent request and on resume.
author: Kenn Costales
